The '''Exploration Dome''' was an underwater structure located under the [[Manaan Visitor's Center]] on the planet [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. It was ran by the [[Department of Selkath Ethnology]], a sub-organization of the [[Office of Extraplanetary Relations]], in order to promote and preserve [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] culture. The Exploration Dome was built below the surface to allow individuals to observe Manaan flora and fauna in their natural environment.<ref name="Codex"/>

The Exploration Dome was taken over by the [[Syphus Collective]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:US" />
